verdicts.decision_note: The client supplies revised About-page title, technology, process, feature, and vision copy to be rendered on the site.
The client leaves the About-page reward-delivery wording materially unresolved between automatic payment and a one-click claim flow.
The revised Small and Big Block amounts and sales triggers require the About page's rendered prize-draw copy to replace its obsolete figures.
The client establishes direct wallet delivery and dashboard/email notification behavior, requiring the About process copy to stop describing prize collection as an unrestricted one-click claim.
The client's immediate acceptance of removing Aave requires deletion of the obsolete Aave technology and yield-generation copy from the rendered About page.
Removing Big Blocks requires the About page's ticket and prize-draw copy to describe only the continuing Small Block mechanism.
The client explicitly revises relevant site copy for one ticket per referral, a $500 drawing every 100 sales, and automatic wallet delivery with dashboard and email notification.
The client unambiguously accepts a separate user-initiated finalization transaction for no-code rewards, requiring corresponding caveats in the About page's referral and automatic-reward copy.
The client's contextual acceptance establishes that prize winners use a conditionally displayed claim button, requiring the About reward-delivery and automatic-reward copy to reflect that claim flow.
